note: Machine-checkable projection of the handoff rubric. The scorer (scripts/score_rubric.py) reads THIS file, never hard-codes the rubric. Bump `version` and add a sibling rubric.vN.md whenever a check, weight, or threshold changes; record the why in references/tuning-log.md.
v2_changes: See references/rubric.v2.md. (1) Items that ~100% of the 2026-10-23 corpus failed are marked `floor: true` (correlation, dead_ends, all frontmatter fields + frontmatter_complete): they flag a universal post-convention gap but do not RANK prompts, so the craft composite is computed over NON-floor weight only, and a `convention_composite` over everything is reported alongside. (2) no_bare_cross_bundle_script_paths is skipped when the handoff targets a home_repo (archive-local scripts are legitimately repo-relative there) — removes the false positives on the 4 launcher-era prompts.

frontmatter_fields.rationale: registry join key; without it the handoff cannot be correlated to its child
pinned model; drives dispatch -SetEnv and the child's /model decision
dispatch reads it for the worktree base
dispatch reads it for the worktree branch
dispatch reads it for the repo path

sections.rationale: point at repo conventions; do not restate them
without the child self-report, child_sid stays null forever and dynamic measurement is impossible
verified facts the child must not re-derive
prevents the child re-walking abandoned approaches
dependency sequence plus the why, so the child holds the line
merge/report/stop; must not self-delete the prompt
explicit cheap-model default for mechanical fan-out
the cheap-model bet needs a scoreboard; required last step before finishing
terse, single decision list, verified counts
state which model was pinned and why, so the child can /model switch sensibly

checks.rationale: dispatch and the registry both read these fields
an untagged state claim is a defect; a confidently-wrong untagged count sends the child down a false path with no one to catch it
a bare scripts/ path to a sibling bundle resolves against the child's OWN repo root, where it does not exist, and reads as never-scaffolded
a child that reads the repo's worktree convention will create a SECOND worktree and split its work unless told the tree already exists

scoring.note: composite = 100 * (earned weight / total weight). A section earns full weight when its heading is present AND at least one body_pattern matches (body_patterns empty => heading presence alone). Checks earn by their own kind. Composite is a coverage proxy, not a quality guarantee.
